_comment: Editorial rules for cleaning imported email bodies (rule 9: editorial content lives in config, not Python). footer_start_phrases are matched case-insensitively as substrings; footer_start_regexes are Python regexes. The first footer marker found AFTER at least min_content_lines_before_footer lines of real content truncates everything from that line onward. separator_line_regex matches decorative divider lines (dashes/underscores/etc.) that are stripped everywhere. max_consecutive_blank_lines collapses runs of blank lines.
